crossRefs.note: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom Yahweh has put wisdom and understanding to know…

translations.web: “ ‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that Yahweh has commanded:
translations.bsb: Let every skilled craftsman among you come and make everything that the LORD has commanded:
translations.kjv: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;
translations.asv: And let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that Jehovah hath commanded:
